_how_to: One entry per YouTube video, newest first. Paste the video's link into 'url' (regular videos and Shorts both work; Shorts show in a tall frame). 'watches' lists the folder names of watches the video features, so it shows on those watch pages too. Optional: upload a cover image named after the video id to source/videos (for example xPnFMMdfSJY.jpg) to use instead of YouTube's thumbnail.
